tasks.name: Ingest plan, delivery and billing
tasks.description: Eleven CSV tables uploaded to OneLake Files. Media plan (what was sold), delivery (what ran) and billing (what was invoiced) arrive as three separate systems would deliver them, because the gaps between them are the point.

tasks.name: Lakehouse - ZavaMediaLH
tasks.description: Batch layer. Star schema over seven dimensions and three facts, roughly 65000 rows.

tasks.name: CSV to Delta
tasks.description: Spark notebook. Calendar columns are forced to STRING on purpose: inferred dates break the Direct Lake join downstream.

tasks.name: Live pacing - RT_Zava_Media
tasks.description: Eventhouse and KQL database carrying a trailing window of campaign pacing deltas. Feeds the ontology as a TimeSeries binding, so one question can cross batch and live.

tasks.name: Ontology - ONT_Zava_Media
tasks.description: Fabric IQ. Seven entity types, nine relationships, one TimeSeries binding. Populate and RefreshGraph run as a separate step: creating the ontology does NOT populate the graph, and an empty graph answers every relationship question with nothing, successfully.

tasks.name: Semantic model - SM_Zava_Media
tasks.description: Direct Lake model, around 35 DAX measures, Prep for AI enabled. This is where a delivery-versus-plan figure is defined once, so Fabric and Foundry cannot disagree about it.

tasks.name: Report - Zava_Media_Report
tasks.description: The human-facing view of the same measures the agent quotes.

tasks.name: Data agent - Zava_Media_Analyst
tasks.description: Answers the number, and only the number. Reaches the ontology over GQL and the semantic model over DAX. Consumed from Foundry as a tool, never as a knowledge source. Must be PUBLISHED: a draft is invisible to Foundry and the connection resolves to nothing.

name: Zava Media - plan to answer
description: Media agency analytics: plan versus delivery versus billing, crossed with live pacing, exposed to Foundry as a data agent. The Foundry half (contracts corpus and supervisor) is deliberately absent from this canvas: task flows map Fabric items, and those agents are not Fabric items.
